name: Omarchy Lacquer
author: deunnis
description: One app for how your Omarchy desktop looks. Themes, wallpapers, shuffle and theme generation with a readability check; saved looks you can carry to another machine; fonts, text rendering, icons and the mouse pointer; window shape, borders built from your theme, glass, shadow and the colour behind your windows; one motion feel or every animation on its own; screens, night light, lock and boot; bar and menu style; per-app rules; terminals, btop and every plugin. 370 settings in plain words, live.
